title: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization data, allowing to invoke local…
description: A vulnerability in certain CODESYS Control runtime products allows insufficient restriction of runtime-supplied visualization data. This flaw enables invocation of local COM/ActiveX functionality on the engineering workstation if a user is logged into the runtime and operating a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this by controlling a malicious runtime or performing a man-in-the-middle attack, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.
